meaning_en: many years in the past
example_en: Dinosaurs lived on Earth a long time ago.
examples_extra: They met a long time ago, before the war.
A long time ago, this street was full of shops.
note_fa: «برای گذشتهٔ دور با گذشتهٔ ساده: I met him a long time ago.»

meaning_en: something bad that happens by chance
example_en: He had a car accident yesterday.
examples_extra: He broke his leg in a car accident.
The glass fell by accident, not on purpose.
note_fa: «by accident = تصادفی؛ با by می‌آید نه with.»

meaning_en: rain that contains harmful chemicals from pollution
example_en: Acid rain damages trees and buildings.
examples_extra: Acid rain has damaged the forests in this region.
Factories must reduce the pollution that causes acid rain.
note_fa: «بارانِ آلودهٔ صنعتی؛ در واحد محیط‌زیست کتاب.»

meaning_en: to do something in a particular situation
example_en: We must act now to protect the environment.
examples_extra: The driver acted quickly and avoided the crash.
When the fire started, she acted without panic.
note_fa: «یعنی «عمل کردن» در یک موقعیت؛ مثل act quickly.»

meaning_en: a serious disease that attacks the body's immune system
example_en: Research continues to find a cure for AIDS.
examples_extra: He contracted AIDS in the 1990s and died young.
Doctors are working to find a cure for AIDS.
note_fa: مخفف acquired immune deficiency syndrome؛ با contract می‌آید.

meaning_en: harmful substances in the air
example_en: Air pollution is a big problem in cities.
examples_extra: Cars and factories cause most air pollution.
Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.

meaning_en: A large group of soldiers fighting for a country.
example_en: My grandfather served in the army.
examples_extra: He joined the army when he was eighteen years old.
The army helped people after the terrible flood.
note_fa: در کتاب: join the army (عضو ارتش شدن).

meaning_en: The feeling or mood in a place.
example_en: The restaurant had a lovely atmosphere.
examples_extra: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere.
There was a tense atmosphere in the meeting room.

meaning_en: A sudden, strong start of a disease.
example_en: He had a sudden asthma attack.
examples_extra: He had an asthma attack and needed his inhaler.
She suffered a panic attack before the exam.
note_fa: با have می‌آید: have a heart attack.

meaning_en: A fight between armies or groups.
example_en: The soldiers fought a long battle.
examples_extra: The battle lasted for two hours before the soldiers retreated.
She is fighting a brave battle against her illness.
note_fa: نبرد — هم واقعی (war) هم مجازی: battle against illness.

meaning_en: A weapon that explodes and causes damage.
example_en: The old bomb was safely removed.
examples_extra: The bomb exploded in the busy city centre.
Police found a suspicious bomb near the railway station.

meaning_en: To start suddenly (e.g., a war, fire, disease).
example_en: A fire broke out in the old factory.
examples_extra: A dangerous fire broke out in the kitchen.
War may break out at any time.

meaning_en: An accident where cars hit each other.
example_en: There was a bad car crash on the highway.
examples_extra: He had a car crash on the way to work yesterday morning.
Traffic jams and car crashes are common problems on the roads.
note_fa: یعنی تصادف رانندگی؛ یکی از مشکلات جاده‌ای است.

meaning_en: The amount of carbon dioxide produced by a person.
example_en: We should reduce our carbon footprint to help the planet.
examples_extra: Cycling to work is one way to reduce your carbon footprint.
Scientists warn that our carbon footprint is damaging the planet.
note_fa: ردپای کربنی؛ با فعل reduce می‌آید: reduce your carbon footprint.

meaning_en: To have a gun with you.
example_en: It is illegal for civilians to carry guns in many countries.
examples_extra: Some of the policemen are not allowed to carry guns.
In that country, ordinary people may not carry guns.
note_fa: اسلحه حمل کردن؛ معمولاً درباره پلیس یا ارتش به‌کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: A person injured or killed in an accident or war.
example_en: There were many casualties in the earthquake.
examples_extra: Several casualties were taken to hospital after the accident.
The war caused thousands of casualties on both sides.
note_fa: قربانی حادثه یا جنگ؛ جمع casualties.

meaning_en: A serious disease causing severe diarrhoea.
example_en: Cholera can spread quickly in poor areas.
examples_extra: Cholera can spread quickly through dirty drinking water.
Many children fell ill with cholera last year.
note_fa: بیماری وبا؛ از طریق آب آلوده منتقل می‌شود.

meaning_en: A war between groups in the same country.
example_en: The country suffered a long civil war.
examples_extra: The small country suffered a long civil war.
A civil war broke out between the two regions.
note_fa: جنگ داخلی؛ جنگ بین گروه‌های یک کشور.

meaning_en: Changes in global weather patterns.
example_en: Climate change is a serious global problem.
examples_extra: Climate change is slowly warming the whole planet.
Governments must take action on climate change now.

meaning_en: Protecting animals, plants, and natural resources.
example_en: Wildlife conservation is very important.
examples_extra: The park is important for wildlife conservation.
She works for a nature conservation organisation.
note_fa: حفاظت از طبیعت؛ conservation area منطقه‌ی حفاظت‌شده.

meaning_en: To make something new exist.
example_en: She wants to create a new website.
examples_extra: The artist created a beautiful painting.
They created a new account online.
note_fa: «به وجود آوردن»؛ create a problem هم رایج است.

meaning_en: Full of people or things, with little space.
example_en: The market was very crowded today.
examples_extra: The bus was so crowded that we had to stand.
The market is always crowded on Saturday mornings.

meaning_en: (n) Harm or injury. (v) To harm or injure something.
example_en: The storm caused a lot of damage.
examples_extra: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
Smoking can damage your health.
note_fa: در معنای خسارت غیرقابل شمارش است.

meaning_en: No longer alive.
example_en: The plant is dead, I forgot to water it.
examples_extra: The flowers are dead because nobody watered them.
He was found dead in his flat yesterday.
note_fa: اشتباه رایج: dead صفت است نه فعل (died).

meaning_en: The end of life.
example_en: His death was a great loss.
examples_extra: Her death was a great shock to everyone.
The death of the old king was announced today.
note_fa: مرگ؛ دقت شود: died فعل، dead صفت است.

meaning_en: To protect someone or something from attack.
example_en: Soldiers defend their country from enemies.
examples_extra: Soldiers defended the city against the invaders.
She defended her friend when others criticised him.
note_fa: defend against/from می‌آید؛ در حقوق: defend a client (دفاع از موکل).

meaning_en: To damage something so badly it cannot exist.
example_en: The fire destroyed the old building.
examples_extra: The fire destroyed half of the forest.
A virus destroyed all his computer files.
note_fa: کتاب: a virus put on a computer to destroy files.

meaning_en: The act of damaging something so badly it cannot exist.
example_en: The earthquake caused widespread destruction in the city.
examples_extra: The war caused terrible destruction in the city.
The destruction of the forest worried environmentalists.

meaning_en: To stop living.
example_en: My old dog died last year.
examples_extra: Her grandfather died peacefully in his sleep last year.
Many old trees die when the winter is too cold.
note_fa: «pass away» مؤدبانه‌تر از die است؛ شکل گذشته died و اسم death.

meaning_en: A sudden event causing great damage or loss.
example_en: The earthquake was a terrible disaster.
examples_extra: The earthquake was a terrible disaster for the whole region.
The wedding was a complete disaster because of the rain.
note_fa: natural disaster یعنی بلای طبیعی؛ disastrous یعنی «فاجعه‌بار».

meaning_en: To get rid of something, especially by throwing it away.
example_en: Please dispose of your rubbish properly.
examples_extra: Please dispose of your rubbish in the bins provided.
The company disposes of its waste in a safe way.
note_fa: ساختار: dispose of something یعنی «دور انداختن».

meaning_en: A long period with no rain.
example_en: The country is suffering from a severe drought.
examples_extra: The drought lasted for six months.
Farmers suffered badly during the drought.
note_fa: یعنی خشکسالی طولانی؛ متضادش flood است.

meaning_en: A sudden violent shaking of the ground.
example_en: There was a big earthquake last night.
examples_extra: The earthquake damaged many buildings in the city.
They felt a small earthquake early this morning.

meaning_en: Related to the environment and living things.

examples_extra: The factory must follow strict ecological rules.
Ecological problems affect the whole planet.
note_fa: با ecological damage و ecological balance زیاد می‌آید.

meaning_en: Good for the environment; not causing harm.
example_en: This new product is ecologically sound and sustainable.
examples_extra: The company tries to be ecologically sound in its production.
Recycling is an ecologically sound way to reduce waste.
note_fa: یعنی سازگار با محیط زیست؛ sound اینجا یعنی سالم/بی‌ضرر.

meaning_en: A change that happens because of something.
example_en: The medicine had a good effect on me.
examples_extra: The new law had a big effect on small businesses.
Sunlight has a strong effect on our mood.
note_fa: effect اسم است (نتیجه)؛ فعلش affect است: affect the result.

meaning_en: Working well without wasting time or energy.
example_en: The new system is very efficient.
examples_extra: She is a very efficient worker and never wastes time.
We need a more efficient way to do this.

meaning_en: At risk of disappearing forever.
example_en: Many species are endangered due to climate change.
examples_extra: Tigers are an endangered species.
Many plants are endangered because of pollution.
note_fa: معمولاً با species می‌آید: endangered species.

meaning_en: A person or group that hates another.
example_en: They were once enemies, but now they are friends.
examples_extra: His old enemy apologized to him last year.
They defeated their enemy in the final battle.

meaning_en: The power to do work or be active.
example_en: We need more clean energy sources.
examples_extra: I don't have the energy to go out tonight.
Solar panels turn sunlight into energy.

meaning_en: The natural world around us.
example_en: We must protect our environment.
examples_extra: We must protect the environment for future generations.
A quiet environment helps students concentrate better.
note_fa: the environment یعنی طبیعت؛ بدون the یعنی محیط اطراف.

meaning_en: Not harmful to the natural world.
example_en: We buy environmentally friendly cleaning products.
examples_extra: This environmentally friendly packaging can be recycled easily.
Many companies now sell environmentally friendly cleaning products.
note_fa: دوستدار محیط‌زیست؛ eco-friendly هم‌معنی کوتاه‌تر است.

meaning_en: A rapid spread of a disease in a community.
example_en: The city faced an epidemic of flu.
examples_extra: The epidemic spread quickly through the crowded city.
Doctors worked hard to control the flu epidemic.
note_fa: همه‌گیری بیماری؛ از pandemic کوچک‌تر است.

meaning_en: To burst out suddenly, like a volcano.
example_en: The volcano might erupt soon.
examples_extra: The volcano erupted without any warning last night.
The crowd erupted into cheers when the team scored.
note_fa: فوران؛ erupt into laughter یعنی «ترکیدن از خنده».

meaning_en: More than is necessary, normal, or reasonable.
example_en: Don't use excessive amounts of water.
examples_extra: The club charges excessive fees for new members.
Excessive use of phones can harm your sleep.
note_fa: بیش از حد؛ منفی‌تر از much است.

meaning_en: To be real or to be present.
example_en: Do aliens really exist?
examples_extra: Many rare species exist only in this forest.
Do aliens really exist somewhere in the universe?

meaning_en: The state of being real or present.
example_en: The existence of ghosts is debated.
examples_extra: The discovery proved the existence of ancient life.
She questioned the existence of true love.

meaning_en: To burst suddenly with great force and noise.

examples_extra: Fireworks explode with bright colours in the sky.
The balloon exploded with a loud bang.

meaning_en: A sudden, violent bursting with loud noise.
example_en: The explosion caused a lot of damage.
examples_extra: The explosion shattered windows across the street.
They heard a loud explosion near the factory.

meaning_en: No longer existing; all of a species have died out.
example_en: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.
examples_extra: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.
The dodo is an extinct bird from Mauritius.
note_fa: همیشه با become می‌آید: become extinct.

meaning_en: A severe lack of food over a large area.
example_en: The country suffered from a terrible famine.
examples_extra: The drought caused a terrible famine.
Millions suffered during the famine.
note_fa: با drought (خشکسالی) و starve هم‌معنا می‌آید.

meaning_en: An unpleasant emotion caused by danger.
example_en: Many people live in fear of war.
examples_extra: She felt fear when the lights went out.
His greatest fear is deep water.

meaning_en: To use violence or arguments against someone.
example_en: They had to fight for their rights.
examples_extra: The two brothers used to fight over the television remote every evening.
They fought bravely against the invaders to protect their village.
note_fa: «دعوا کردن»؛ اسم هم هست: a fight.

meaning_en: A large amount of water covering land.
example_en: The heavy rain caused a flood.
examples_extra: The flood damaged hundreds of houses in the valley.
After the heavy rain, the streets were in flood.
note_fa: سیل؛ the floods یعنی سیل‌های آن سال.

meaning_en: To cover with a large amount of water.
example_en: The river might flood the town.
examples_extra: Heavy rain flooded the basement of our house.
The river flooded the fields after three days of rain.
note_fa: «سیلاب زدن و غرق کردن»؛ شکل فعل flood است.

meaning_en: a large fire burning in a forest.
example_en: The forest fire spread quickly.
examples_extra: A forest fire destroyed hundreds of trees.
Dry weather increases the risk of forest fires.

meaning_en: fuel like coal or oil from ancient plants.
example_en: Burning fossil fuels harms the environment.
examples_extra: Cars still depend on fossil fuels.
Burning fossil fuels causes pollution.

meaning_en: a substance like air, used for fuel.
example_en: Burning too much gas causes pollution.
examples_extra: The house is heated by gas.
Turn off the gas before you leave.
note_fa: در آمریکا gasoline = بنزین؛ در بریتانیا petrol.

meaning_en: to escape from a person or place.
example_en: The thief managed to get away.
examples_extra: The thief got away before the police arrived.
She managed to get away from the crowd.
note_fa: فرار کردن؛ get away with یعنی «از مجازات فرار کردن».

meaning_en: Relating to the whole world.
example_en: Global warming is a big problem.
examples_extra: Climate change is a global problem.
She works for a global company.

meaning_en: The increase in the world's temperature.
example_en: Global warming affects everyone.
examples_extra: Global warming is melting the polar ice.
We must fight global warming together.
note_fa: یعنی گرم شدن کرهٔ زمین؛ با climate change مرتبط ولی متفاوت است.

meaning_en: The process of businesses operating internationally.
example_en: Globalisation has changed the world economy.
examples_extra: Globalisation has changed the way we do business.
Critics say globalisation hurts small shops.

meaning_en: the color of grass or leaves.
example_en: She has beautiful green eyes.
examples_extra: The grass is very green.
She wore a green dress.

meaning_en: warming of Earth's surface due to trapped gases.
example_en: The greenhouse effect is causing climate change.
examples_extra: The greenhouse effect warms the Earth.
Cars add to the greenhouse effect.

meaning_en: gases that trap heat in Earth's atmosphere.
example_en: Carbon dioxide is one of the greenhouse gases.
examples_extra: Greenhouse gases trap heat in the air.
Factories produce a lot of greenhouse gases.

meaning_en: A weapon that shoots bullets.
example_en: The police officer carried a gun.
examples_extra: The police officer carried a gun on his belt.
He pointed the gun at the target and fired.
note_fa: اسلحه گرم؛ point a gun یعنی «نشانه گرفتن».

meaning_en: Dangerous, especially to health or safety.
example_en: Hazardous waste must be handled carefully.
examples_extra: These chemicals are hazardous to human health.
Driving in thick fog is extremely hazardous.

meaning_en: The central part of a place.
example_en: The restaurant is in the heart of the city.
examples_extra: The hotel is in the heart of the city.
We live in the heart of the countryside.
note_fa: قلب و مرکز یک مکان؛ in the heart of.

meaning_en: To put something where it cannot be seen.
example_en: The children like to hide in the garden.
examples_extra: The children like to hide behind the sofa.
She tried to hide the keys in her bag.

meaning_en: Without a home.
example_en: Many people are homeless after the earthquake.
examples_extra: The charity helps homeless people.
He became homeless after losing his job.

meaning_en: Feeling a need to eat food.
example_en: I am hungry, let's eat.
examples_extra: The children were hungry after school.
I'm too hungry to wait for dinner.

meaning_en: A very strong storm with powerful winds and rain.
example_en: The hurricane caused a lot of damage.
examples_extra: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
A hurricane is coming to the coast.

meaning_en: A violent storm with very strong winds, especially in the Atlantic.
example_en: The hurricane hit the coast with immense force.
examples_extra: Hurricanes bring strong winds and heavy rain.
The town prepared for the coming hurricane.
note_fa: در آمریکا hurricane، در آسیا typhoon گفته می‌شود.

meaning_en: An event, often unpleasant or unusual.
example_en: There was a small incident at the protest.
examples_extra: The police are investigating a serious incident.
The whole incident lasted only a few minutes.

meaning_en: To hurt yourself or someone else.
example_en: Be careful not to injure yourself.
examples_extra: Two players were injured in the match.
She badly injured her knee while skiing.

meaning_en: To make someone or something die.
example_en: Hunting animals can kill many species.
examples_extra: Smoking too much can kill you.
The farmer killed a snake in the field.

meaning_en: To not have enough of something.
example_en: The project failed due to a lack of funding.
examples_extra: They lack clean drinking water.
He lacks confidence in himself.

meaning_en: A large mass of earth and rocks falling down a slope.
example_en: Heavy rain caused a dangerous landslide.
examples_extra: The landslide blocked the road.
Heavy rain caused a landslide.
note_fa: ریزش کوه؛ در انتخابات یعنی «پیروزی قاطع».

meaning_en: very important or serious.
example_en: This is a major problem for the company.
examples_extra: This is a major problem for the city.
She played a major role in the film.
note_fa: کتاب: major accident؛ یعنی «عمده/مهم»؛ مقابل minor.

meaning_en: A serious disease from mosquito bites.
example_en: Malaria is common in hot countries.
examples_extra: Malaria is spread by mosquitoes.
He caught malaria in Africa.

meaning_en: Created by humans, not nature.

examples_extra: This beautiful lake is man-made.
Plastic is a man-made material.

meaning_en: A person who moves to another place.

examples_extra: Many migrants come here for work.
The city welcomes new migrants.

meaning_en: not present; lost or not found
example_en: My keys are missing. I can't find them.
examples_extra: Two pages are missing from the book.
The missing child was found safe.

meaning_en: Existing in nature, not made by humans.
example_en: We need to protect our natural environment.
examples_extra: She possesses such rare and effortless natural beauty.
It is completely natural to feel nervous sometimes.

meaning_en: A terrible event caused by nature.
example_en: Earthquakes are a type of natural disaster.
examples_extra: The earthquake was a terrible natural disaster.
Floods are the most common natural disaster here.
note_fa: بلای طبیعی؛ مثل earthquake و flood.

meaning_en: A black liquid from the ground used as fuel.

examples_extra: The country exports a lot of oil.
Oil prices rose again this week.
note_fa: یعنی نفت خام؛ با cooking oil اشتباه نگیرید.

meaning_en: Officially written or stated.

examples_extra: Her statement is on record now.

meaning_en: Refusing to work as a protest.

examples_extra: The teachers are on strike today.
Bus drivers went on strike last week.
note_fa: go on strike یعنی اعتصاب کردن.

meaning_en: Grown without artificial chemicals.
example_en: I prefer to buy organic vegetables.
examples_extra: She buys only organic vegetables.
Organic food costs more than usual.

meaning_en: Too many people in one place.
example_en: Overcrowding is a problem in big cities.
examples_extra: Overcrowding is a problem in big cities.
The school suffers from overcrowding.

meaning_en: Catching too many fish, harming populations.
example_en: Overfishing is a serious environmental issue.
examples_extra: Overfishing is harming sea life.
The government wants to stop overfishing.

meaning_en: Having too many people for the available resources.

examples_extra: The city is badly overpopulated.
This area is becoming overpopulated.

meaning_en: A situation with too many people in an area.

examples_extra: Overpopulation causes many serious problems.
The country is worried about overpopulation.

meaning_en: Reduction of the ozone layer in the atmosphere.
example_en: Ozone depletion is a serious environmental concern.
examples_extra: Ozone depletion is an environmental problem.
Scientists study ozone depletion closely.

meaning_en: to put a plant or seed in the ground.

examples_extra: They planted trees in the park.
She plants flowers every spring.

meaning_en: A large area of ice at the North or South Pole.

examples_extra: The polar ice cap is melting.
Polar bears live near the polar ice cap.

meaning_en: Dirty and harmful, especially air or water.
example_en: The river water is very polluted.
examples_extra: The river is badly polluted.
The air is polluted here.

meaning_en: Harmful things in the air, water, or land.
example_en: Air pollution is a big problem.
examples_extra: Pollution is a serious problem.
The factory causes air pollution.

meaning_en: Having very little money.
example_en: Many poor families need help.
examples_extra: They are very poor people.
She comes from a poor family.

meaning_en: A difficult situation that needs a solution.
example_en: We have a big problem.
examples_extra: We have a serious problem.

meaning_en: To keep someone or something safe.

examples_extra: Wear a helmet to protect your head.

meaning_en: a serious disease from animal bites

examples_extra: The dog was tested for rabies.
Rabies is a dangerous disease.

meaning_en: a thick forest in tropical areas with much rain

examples_extra: The Amazon is the largest rainforest.
Many animals live in the rainforest.

meaning_en: The process of making new things from old materials.
example_en: Recycling helps protect our planet.
examples_extra: Recycling paper helps to save many trees.
Our city has a good recycling programme.

meaning_en: To make something smaller or less.

examples_extra: We need to reduce the amount of sugar we eat.

meaning_en: A person who has left their country because of war.

examples_extra: The charity helps refugees find new homes.

meaning_en: To book something for future use.

meaning_en: The effect or outcome of an event.

meaning_en: The time when many people travel to or from work.

examples_extra: Avoid the city centre in rush hour.

meaning_en: To keep something safe or for later.

examples_extra: Save some cake for me.

meaning_en: (n) An act of looking for something; (v) to look for.

meaning_en: to move quickly from side to side or up and down

meaning_en: To kill an animal with a gun.

examples_extra: The hunters shoot wild birds every single autumn.

meaning_en: A very poor and crowded area of a city.

examples_extra: We must tighten our belts.
Families are tightening their belts.

meaning_en: Poisonous waste materials that harm the environment.
example_en: Proper disposal of toxic waste is crucial for public health.
examples_extra: The factory dumped toxic waste.
Toxic waste harms the river.

meaning_en: An agreement between enemies to stop fighting.
example_en: The warring factions agreed to a temporary truce.
examples_extra: They agreed on a temporary truce.
The truce lasted two weeks.

meaning_en: Exercising power cruelly and oppressively.
example_en: The tyrannical regime suppressed all forms of dissent.
examples_extra: The country suffered under a tyrannical ruler.
His tyrannical boss fired everyone.

meaning_en: Not restrained or managed; wild.
example_en: Uncontrolled deforestation leads to significant environmental damage.
examples_extra: The fire spread uncontrolled through the forest.
Uncontrolled anger is dangerous for your health.

meaning_en: A state of dissatisfaction or disturbance.
example_en: Social unrest often leads to political instability.
examples_extra: There was unrest in the capital.
The country faces growing unrest.

meaning_en: An act of breaking a law or rule.
example_en: The company was fined for environmental violations.
examples_extra: The act was a clear violation.
All violations will be punished.

meaning_en: To start or continue a war or fight against something.
example_en: The government vowed to wage war on corruption.
examples_extra: They wage war on poverty.
The government wages war on drugs.
note_fa: جنگ علیه چیزی به راه انداختن.

meaning_en: The process of getting rid of unwanted materials.
example_en: Proper waste disposal is essential for environmental protection.
examples_extra: The city improved waste disposal.
Waste disposal costs rose sharply.

meaning_en: Reliable access to sufficient, safe, and affordable water.
example_en: Climate change poses a significant threat to global water security.
examples_extra: Water security is a growing concern.
The region lacks water security.

meaning_en: Energy generated from the movement of ocean waves.
example_en: Wave power is a promising source of renewable energy.
examples_extra: Wave power could supply clean energy.
They invest in wave power.

meaning_en: Weapons collectively, especially military weapons.
example_en: The rebels acquired advanced weaponry from foreign sources.
examples_extra: The army displayed its weaponry.
Modern weaponry is very deadly.

meaning_en: An area of land with many wind turbines for electricity.
example_en: The new wind farm will generate clean energy.
examples_extra: A wind farm powers the town.
They built a wind farm offshore.

meaning_en: the worst possible outcome or situation.
example_en: We must plan for the worst-case scenario, just in case.
examples_extra: Plan for the worst-case scenario.
The dreaded worst-case scenario finally happened.
